source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The reply-identity setup assigns the new server to its account and adds identities before creating the Replies subfolder. The historical helper created the folder too early. Fixed setup keeps the corrected order. This is the inspected fixture dependency, not a new production guard or proof every folder API requires the same sequence. No reply test ran.
title: Associate a fixture server with its account before creating folders
